title: How Damon Chen acquired PDF.ai and grew it past $50K MRR
summary: Damon Chen explains how he bought a weekend-built AI project, rebranded it to PDF.ai, validated demand with a $99 lifetime deal, and grew it mostly through organic search thanks to an exact-match domain. He also shares what he would do differently: influencer marketing and partnerships.

principles.text: Buy a validated, hyped weekend project instead of starting from zero.
principles.quote: It creates some hype when being announced on social media. It's kind of like validation to me. When the project was listed for sale, it grabbed my attention, and eventually I acquired it.

principles.text: Use a lifetime deal to test willingness to pay and fund the build.
principles.quote: I offered a lifetime deal at $99. With over 300 adopters within a 3-month campaign, it provided enough validation for the monetization aspect and strong financial support to invest more effort into growing PDF.ai.

principles.text: Reinvest early revenue into a full-time engineer.
principles.quote: I used the revenue from the LTD to hire a full-time engineer to work on it.

principles.text: A relevant, exact-match domain name is a top SEO and marketing asset.
principles.quote: Top marketing effort is the relevant domain name. The domain name explicitly tells Google what we do, and our product is exactly like the domain says.

principles.text: A good domain helps you compete for difficult keywords early.
principles.quote: So picking a good, relevant domain for your business will give you a head start in competing for some difficult keywords.

principles.text: Don't rely only on shipping features and waiting for virality; add influencer and partnership channels.
principles.quote: If I were to do it differently, I would explore more marketing channels, collaborate with influencers in their respective spaces
